descriptor.name: Florida Statewide Cadastral (Department of Revenue)
descriptor.operator: Florida Department of Revenue, Property Tax Oversight, from the 67 county property appraisers
descriptor.scope: Florida DOR statewide cadastral polygons joined to the county tax rolls for all 67 counties (10,950,718 rows on 2026-10-12). Canonical identity is the DOR county number plus roll PARCEL_ID; same-key rows form one native parcel group. The 97,244 polygons with no roll join (CO_NO 0, blank PARCEL_ID) are outside this source.
caveats: PARCEL_ID is county-scoped, so identity is the reversible composite CO_NO~PARCEL_ID.

Many roll parcels are stored as several polygon rows (e.g. 86 rows for one Hillsborough condominium parcel); all components are fetched and unioned. Some components overlap slightly (largest observed 0.79 m2), so overlap is not rejected for this provider.
The layer carries owner, address and sale columns; only CO_NO, PARCEL_ID and OBJECTID are requested.
Statewide envelope queries are slow (about 11 s for a 0.01 degree box, 18 s for 46 object IDs); small cells are required.
descriptor.attribution: Florida Department of Revenue, Property Tax Oversight, and Florida county property appraisers. Adapted to WGS84.
descriptor.licenceNote: Source conditions are informational; users choose their source and intended use.

jurisdiction.basis: The DOR layer is collected annually from all 67 Florida county property appraisers; all 67 county numbers are present in the live layer.

evidence: The DOR layer is collected annually from all 67 Florida county property appraisers; all 67 county numbers are present in the live layer.
